data.objective: Mark, I want to start an embedded project using the development board connected to this Linux device. Identify the hardware, plan the project, analyze the system requirements, determine the hardware and software architecture, prepare the firmware, build it, ask for my approval before programming, program the board, test it, and prepare a complete engineering report.
data.scope: Plan, requirements, architecture, hardware analysis, firmware design, build, approved programming, verification, and engineering report.
dependencies: Active Project OS project with workspace
Hardware discovery evidence from Engineering OS
risks: Missing toolchain or programmer on host
Missing serial ACM for runtime verification
assumptions: User wants a basic LED blink bring-up as the first qualification scenario unless otherwise stated
required_decisions: Confirm programming after reviewing artifact hash
Clarify board if discovery is ambiguous
acceptance_criteria: Firmware build evidence captured via Device Broker
Verification distinguishes evidence-backed vs unverified results
